criterion_fired: Criterion 1 (Evidence Quality), Criterion 3 (Identified Pain Evidence), Criterion 4 (Next Steps Specificity), Criterion 5 (ICP Fit Claims)
suggested_change: Criterion 3 wording: 'Identified Pain must include at least one direct prospect quote stating business impact, urgency, or quantified cost; technical feature descriptions or seller-inferred needs do not qualify.' Criterion 4 wording: 'Next steps must begin with a specific action verb (Ask, Request, Propose with confirmation method, Schedule, Send) and include named contact and exact question/deliverable; vague verbs (Confirm, Map, Discuss, Propose without closure) are not acceptable.'
